<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>I’ve been pondering our problem for a bit—how to raise
the <$cdef(27)>mood...
<$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>And I believe I’ve come up with a humdinger of an idea!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Do you recall how we’ve occasionally excavated <$cdef(27)>lost relics
left by humans?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Well, what do you think about displaying those at the
party venue?

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,7)>I’d love nothing more than to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(25)> those <$cdef(27)>lost relics
and discover what exactly they are.
<$comeff(1,21)><$voicel(1,10)>And by displaying them, we might help others remember
the times when humans were still here. You know—create
a nostalgic atmosphere.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,5)><$cdef(27)><$cname;0(274)> was talking about “vibes”
and such...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Surely this is the kind of thing they meant! So what do
you say?

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Hohoho! Glad to hear it! In that case, may I ask you to
display <$cdef(27)>one <$cdef(27)><$ifull(3997)> <$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)>in the party venue?

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Oho! This place is really shaping up into something
special! Do you suppose the <$cdef(27)>mood has risen a bit?

<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>By the way, I’m certain <$cdef(27)>lost relics aren’t the only things that
could help get folks in a more festive <$cdef(27)>mood.
